verdict.rationale: Swell offers general extension mechanisms—serverless functions for custom logic, webhooks, custom models/fields, and Liquid theme customization—that could plausibly be applied to checkout, and cross-sell/upsell at checkout is mentioned, but there is no documentation specifically describing checkout page field customization, checkout branding controls, or checkout-specific validation hooks as a supported extension point. Missing for 10: explicit checkout page/field customization API or theme section, checkout-specific validation hook docs, discount/promo configuration tied to checkout flow, and any hands-on example of extending checkout without forking.
